bullets.title: Durigutti Malbec 2015
bullets.note:
(Mendoza, Argentina). Although I lived in Argentina from 2004-2005 and drank a
lot of South American red wine, I first had this Malbec in 2015 at an Italian
restaurant on Long Island. In December 2016, I found a bottle at retail for
the first time in Portland, Oregon, where it cost $15. This is an amazing
bang-for-the-buck Malbec, no matter how you slice it.
